event: Nimue reaches for the third answer: the cold reach toward the System's own readout.
The Tower makes the reflex permanent; she feels a lens seat behind her eye, cold and exact.

memory.fact: At the threshold the System kept Nimue's third reflex, the cold clean analytical reach.
Nimue felt the anchoring as a lens seating into place behind her eye, cold and exact.
At the Floor-1 entry the System reviewed the subject's first hour and kept one reflex.

event: Her sight turns the pole into a list: weight, balance, the bent place near the cuff.

memory.fact: Nimue's Seer-sight reads the world as structure and failure points.
To Nimue's Seer-sight a steel pole becomes a list: weight here, balance there.
Nimue's Seer-sight shows the bent place near the pole's cuff where it would fail.
To Nimue's Seer-sight, System text waits at the edges of things.

event: The System: ANCHOR SET, THE SEER. Open Eye fills Essence Slot 1.

memory.fact: The System anchored Nimue as THE SEER.
Nimue's foundation essence is the Open Eye, in slot 1.

event: Anchoring lean applied, +2 ATT and +1 INS: ATT 12, INS 11, HP 100, Focus 60, Strike 20.

changes.note: The Open Eye anchor's lean adds 2 ATT
The Open Eye anchor's lean adds 1 INS

event: The numbers settle like a diagnosis: a way of seeing, not strength or speed.

memory.fact: Being the Seer is who Nimue now is: a way of seeing, not strength or speed.
Nimue is the same woman who couldn't open a stuck jar without bracing it on her hip.

event: She sets the pole's foot on the line and steps through.
The seam closes over her like water: a low black ceiling, and no way back.

memory.fact: The Charnel Den is the first floor of the Tower.
The Charnel Den is a lightless room with a low black ceiling close overhead.
Stepping through the seam feels like going under.
The seam closes seamlessly behind, and there is no going back.

event: Her eyes will not adjust; the only light is her own Open Eye icon.

memory.fact: The dark in the den is total and eats the System-glow a foot past one's hands.
Eyes never adjust in the den; the only light is one's own interface.

event: The floor is ankle-deep pale grit, fine as cremation ash.

memory.fact: The den's floor is ankle-deep ash, pale and fine as cremation ash.
The den's ash shifts like sand and crunches underfoot.

event: She counts the room by smell: dry mineral ash over a thick digesting reek.

memory.fact: The den smells of dry mineral ash over a thick digesting reek, like a wound dressed too long.

event: The den is silent, like something holding its breath, and cold as a body on a table.

memory.fact: The den is cold: a still, dead, used-up cold, like a walk-in cooler or a body on a table.
The den is a place that ate everything warm in it long ago and kept nothing back.
The den is silent in the way of a place where something is holding its breath.
The Tower's hum persists in the den.

event: She understands she is the one warm thing in the room, burning like a lamp.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton hunts heat and needs no eyes.
A living climber is the one warm thing in the den, about 98.6°F, burning like a lamp.
A living climber is the most huntable thing in the den.
A climber's warmth is all that is worth finding in the den.

event: She stands still, pole low and crosswise, and waits to be found.
Ash pours off a great slow shape rising close, ahead and to her left.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton is a great slow bulk.
The Ash-Glutton lies buried in its own ash with its breath held.
The Ash-Glutton lets the warmest living thing in the room walk to it.
The Charnel Den is the lair of the Ash-Glutton.

event: It breathes in, and the den's whole air bends toward it.
Nimue swings at the inhale; the pole skates off a crust as hard as a kiln.
She strikes again and again; every blow scatters off the fused crust.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton's entire surface is plated in a hard pale crust.
Ordinary strikes skate off the Ash-Glutton's crust uselessly.

event: The creature exhales a cone of pulverized ash into her eyes, mouth and throat.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton exhales a blinding cough, a cone of pulverized ash.
The cough floods a victim's eyes, mouth and throat.

event: Blind and choking, she drops to her knees in the ash.
It surges in and bites; the jaw closes on the pole and her left forearm together.
The crusted jaw grinds her arm; she wrenches free and sprawls.
The System: Hostile contact. You are bleeding heat. It can taste where you are.

memory.fact: A wounded climber bleeds heat and lights itself up for the Ash-Glutton's next bite.

event: Four full blows did nothing and one bite has her losing, like a code started too late.

memory.fact: On Floor 1 Nimue's oldest instinct, to win with her hands, failed against the Ash-Glutton.
Nimue did not beat the Ash-Glutton by force; four full-strength blows did nothing.

event: Aloud she tells herself: stop swinging. You don't win this with your hands.

memory.fact: Nimue said aloud, You don't win this with your hands, and fought with the eye instead.

event: She presses the bleeding arm to her ribs to hide its heat.
She remembers the System kept the eye, not the hands, and means to use it.
She stops looking at the monster and looks for the flaw instead.

memory.fact: Nimue stopped trying to overpower the Ash-Glutton.

event: It lunges, and as it draws breath to cough, Open Eye lights one point.

memory.fact: Nimue used her Open Eye to let the interface paint the one weak point in the dark.

event: Low under the jaw the crust parts over a soft pale throat, swelling on the inhale.

memory.fact: On the inhale a soft pale throat, the Gorge, distends, uncrusted and vulnerable.

event: The System: WEAK POINT, THE GORGE. The soft is only soft on the inhale.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton armors everything but its breath.
To cough, the Ash-Glutton must first inhale.
The Gorge is the Ash-Glutton's one weakness: the soft is only soft on the inhale.

event: She treats it as a code with one right moment: read the swell, hit on the inhale.
She drives the pole up into the lit point, and it goes in soft.

memory.fact: Nimue drove the pole up into the Gorge on the breath.

event: The creature whistles and reels back off the pole; hot fluid sheets over her hands.
Enraged, it rakes her ribs and coughs her blind again.

memory.fact: Nimue's left forearm was bitten and raked by the Ash-Glutton and won't fully close.
Nimue took ash-choked lungs and a raking blow across the ribs from the Ash-Glutton.

event: She has the rhythm now: bait the heat, let it commit, wait for the inhale.

memory.fact: Nimue learned the Ash-Glutton's inhale-rhythm.

event: As it rears to cough she spends her active and Reads it.

memory.fact: Floor Spawn, Threshold Warden, Tier 0 hostile, weak point and Read are System terms.

event: READ: the crust is a hollow shell; it cannot mend, and it cannot outlast her.

memory.fact: The crust is a shell, and the shell is hollow; it has spent its city's worth of fuel.

event: She understands it is a husk: all shell and one soft breath.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton is a husk: fat with what it ate, brittle underneath.
The Ash-Glutton is all shell and one soft breath.

event: Open Eye shows the crust is fused human bone: knuckle, rib and skull.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton's crust is not stone but fused human bone.
The crust is thousands of sintered shards of knuckle, rib and skull, pressed into armor.

event: It armored itself in the unascended dead, swept down to the Tower's root and eaten.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton ate and wore culled dead swept down to the Tower's root.
The thinning to ozone was not annihilation.
Not all the culled were tidied cleanly.

event: She recognizes her city in it: the bus-wheel man, the woman with the oranges.

memory.fact: Mid-fight Nimue learned the Ash-Glutton was her city, digested and stood up again to kill her.
The crust's shards were scraped from the culled dead, Nimue's own neighbors.
The crust holds the bus-wheel man and the oranges woman, dead Nimue passed in the dead city.
The Charnel Den is the literal grave of part of the dead city.
The den's ash floor is made of the culled unascended.

event: Her hands don't shake; she sets the horror behind the engine for later.

memory.fact: Nimue set the horror behind the engine to survive the fight.

event: She sets her feet, reads the swell, and puts everything into the Gorge on the inhale.
The eye finds the killing line inside the killing line, and she strikes there.

memory.fact: Nimue found the killing line inside the killing line.

event: The creature sags into its own ash with a long exhale and goes still.

memory.fact: A precise strike up into the swollen throat on the inhale kills the Ash-Glutton.

event: She has killed it in a handful of exchanges, because she saw.

memory.fact: Nimue does not overpower a trial; she sees the flaw and strikes the one true line.
The Ash-Glutton was Nimue's first proof that the Tower's trials are solvable by seeing.

event: Kneeling with the pole in the wound, she waits for her hands to shake; they don't.

memory.fact: Nimue's hands did not shake after the fight.
Nimue files every feeling behind the engine, for some room that has a door she could close.

event: Open Eye traces a fine blue-white thread through the dying creature, root to crust.

memory.fact: Nimue's Open Eye traced a fine bright thread of System blue-white through the dying Ash-Glutton.
The thread ran from the Ash-Glutton's root to its crust.
Nimue was shown the thread because she reached for the interface in her worst hour.
Nimue was shown the thread because she made the analytical Eye her foundation.

event: The thread converted the dead into bone-plate and bulk: neither biology nor magic, but System.

memory.fact: The Tower grew the Ash-Glutton from the unascended dead it culled.
The Tower does not merely let monsters eat the dead; it converts them.
The thread is machinery, neither biology nor magic, but System.
The thread threaded through dropped unascended bodies.
The thread turned the unascended into bone-plate, stolen heat and bulk.

event: She understands the Tower grows its trials from the people it has culled.

memory.fact: The Ash-Glutton is the first concrete instance of the Tower growing a trial from its dead.
The Conversion is how the Tower grows its trials.
The dead the Tower culls become the floors.
The floors kill the ascended.
Whatever survives climbs one ring to meet the next thing grown from the next city's dead.

event: The dead are inventory: the Tower keeps what you cannot.

memory.fact: Through the Ash-Glutton Nimue learned what the Tower is.
The dead were not waste to the System. They were inventory.
Nothing the Tower takes is ever truly gone.
What the Tower takes is only waiting to be made into the next reason somebody died.
The Conversion is the literal meaning of: the Tower keeps what you cannot.
The System's cruelty is not malice; it is a closed loop that wastes nothing.

event: Above her she feels a hundred floors, a hundred things grown from a hundred slaughters.

memory.fact: A hundred floors are a hundred trials grown from a hundred slaughters.

event: The System: FLOOR 1, TRIAL COMPLETE. The Ash-Glutton is slain. You ascend.

memory.fact: Nimue has cleared Floor 1; 99 floors are above her.
The Ash-Glutton is the Floor-1 trial of the Tower.

event: Subject note: cleared by precision, not attrition. Recorded.

memory.fact: Nimue cleared the Ash-Glutton by precision, not attrition, in a handful of exchanges.
On Floor 1 the System noted: cleared by precision, not attrition. Recorded.

event: The System turns to offering: HARVEST. Take one piece of the slain into yourself.

memory.fact: The Harvest and the Conversion are the Tower's core mechanic.
The Harvest and the Conversion were revealed to Nimue on Floor 1.
When a trial dies the System stops confirming and offers the Harvest.
The Harvest offer: HARVEST. The slain holds essence. What it was can become what you are.
The Harvest offer: Reach into the slain and take one piece of it into yourself.
At a threshold or a kill, the System turns from narrating to asking and offering.

event: What you take is yours until you trade it away; this is the first never human.

memory.fact: The Harvest offer: What you take is yours until you trade it away. What you trade away is gone.
The Harvest offer: This is the first you will carry that was never human.

event: Essence Slot 2 stands open. Option one is Ash-Hide, the crust as armor.

memory.fact: The Floor-1 carcass offered four pieces.
The first piece the carcass offered was the bone-crust, its armor.

event: Option two is Unhinged Jaw, the bite that broke steel and bone.
Option three is Cinder-Cough, the cone of grave-ash that blinded her.
Option four, seen by her eye alone, is Carrion Bloom, the conversion-thread.

memory.fact: Nimue alone was shown the conversion-thread.
The fourth piece the carcass offered was a thread-reading, offered to Nimue's Eye alone.

event: She feels what is asked: to make a monster a permanent tenant of her flesh.

memory.fact: To harvest is to make a monster a permanent tenant of one's flesh.

event: Each harvest will trade more of her away, until she may not be a woman at all.

memory.fact: A harvest is an irreversible trade of self for the power to keep climbing.
Harvesting starts a chimera arc in which the human and the inhuman mix.
A chimera mixes until one can no longer fully tell which parts are one's own.

event: The fourth piece is a door her eye opened, offered to her and no one else.

memory.fact: Nimue's foundation cracked a door into the Tower's machinery.
Ordinary climbers cannot even see the Tower's machinery is there.

event: To take a piece is to desecrate her city's dead, or to carry them onward.

memory.fact: Nimue's first Harvest is doubled in horror.
For Nimue, to reach in is to desecrate the dead of her city.
For Nimue, to reach in is also to refuse to let the Tower be the only thing that keeps them.
Nimue cannot tell which reaching in would be, or whether the difference exists.

event: She kneels at the carcass, hand not yet extended, and the four lights wait.

memory.fact: Nimue kneels at the Ash-Glutton's carcass, facing her first Harvest decision.
Nimue's first Harvest decision is unresolved.
